name: Huly
description: Huly is an all-in-one project management platform and an alternative to Linear and Jira. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys Huly as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: All-in-one project management, an alternative to Linear and Jira. Self-host Huly on Dokploy in minutes – no manual setup needed.
